label: Precipitation (IMERG)
source: NASA GPM IMERG V07 Final, monthly (GPM_3IMERGM) via Google Earth Engine (NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_MONTHLY_V07)
aggregation: monthly mean rate (mm/hr) x 24 x days in month per 0.1° cell; then mean of the ~1 km cells inside the county (nearest-neighbour from the 0.1° grid = area-weighted mean of the 0.1° cells)
notes: Satellite rainfall estimate (microwave + infrared, gauge-calibrated in the Final run). Oct-Dec 2025 are not yet in the monthly product on Earth Engine and are the mean of the half-hourly IMERG V07 rates (NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V07, status 'provisional' = Late run, not gauge-calibrated). Until Nov 2026 this series came from NASA POWER's 0.5° x 0.625° regridding of IMERG; it now comes from the native 0.1° grid shown on the map (the POWER version is kept as precip_mm_power, hidden).

label: Mean air temperature (2 m)
source: NASA GLDAS-2.1 Noah land surface model, 3-hourly 0.25° (GLDAS_NOAH025_3H v2.1, Tair_f_inst) via Google Earth Engine (NASA/GLDAS/V021/NOAH/G025/T3H)
aggregation: per-pixel mean of all 3-hourly near-surface air temperatures in the month (K - 273.15); then mean of the ~1 km cells inside the county (nearest-neighbour from the 0.25° grid)
notes: Model forcing temperature (GDAS analysis, bias-corrected). Until Nov 2026 this series came from MERRA-2 via NASA POWER (0.5° x 0.625°); it now comes from the 0.25° GLDAS grid shown on the map (the MERRA-2 version is kept as tair_c_power, hidden).
